# FQHESphereLLLProjectedLLLTimesManyLL

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereLLLProjectedLLLTimesManyLL`

```text
FQHESphereLLLProjectedLLLTimesTwoLL, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereLLLProjectedLLLTimesTwoLL [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --fermion : name of the file corresponding to the fermion state in the Two Lowest Landau Level
    --boson : name of the file corresponding to the boson state in the LLL
    --lll-state : name of the file corresponding to the state in the LLL
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state (should be the one of the bosonic state)
    --projection : the state will be projected into the LLL
    --reverse-flux : the fluxes bind to each particle are in the opposite direction than the magnetic field
    --projected-haldane : use an Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis for the projected state
    --projected-referencefile : use a file as the definition of the reference state for the projected state (should be the one of the bosonic state)
    --resume : the last calcul will be resumed from its last save step
    --3-ll : consider particles within three Landau levels
    --4-ll : consider particles within four Landau levels
    --symmetric : Lz->-Lz symmetry used
    --index : create a temporary vector whose index component is put to 1, others to 0. No need of an input file in this case (default value = -1)
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total momentum projection for the system (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = 0)
    --energy-value : value of the total effective cyclotron energy of the states that will be computed (default value = -1)
    --1ll-nbrparticles : constrain the number of particles in the lowest LL (default value = -1)
    --2ll-nbrparticles : constrain the number of particles in the second LL (default value = -1)
    --3ll-nbrparticles : constrain the number of particles in the third LL (default value = -1)
    --4ll-nbrparticles : constrain the number of particles in the fourth LL (default value = -1)
    --resuming-index : index from which the calculation will be resumed in case of interruption in the constain mode (default value = 0)
    --min-component : the min component (default value = 0)
    --nbr-components : the number of component computed (default value = 0)
    --step : number of time the Bosonic will be divided in (default value = 1)
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --interaction-name : interaction name (as it should appear in output files)

output options:
    --normalize : express the projected state in the normalized basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

global options:
```
